I'd be curious to see how Zipline is hoping to expand, at least in the US given these considerations.

text:
A rotary or quad rotor aircraft may do better with Icing protection since the high speeds of a rotor and/or prop could help prevent ice buildup on the airfoil (although ice would still accumulate on the airframe), but another challenge is keeping the batteries at safe operating temps.

Typically, lithium batteries don't like to go below freezing temps as the cold shortens the amount of battery life in a flight and some manufacturers note that the batteries should be above freezing before charging them.

However a solution that could be coming is hydrogen batteries. While I don't know what the temperature limitations would be on those,  they have insane endurance. The drone industry is shaping up to be pretty cool!
